definitions: A warm-up exercise that involves significant physical effort or exertion, often to the point of discomfort or near-maximum capacity.
A preparatory physical activity that pushes the body to its limits before a main event or workout.
examples: The coach designed a straining warm-up to prepare the athletes for the intense competition.
After the straining warm-up, she felt her muscles were fully activated.
He always includes a straining warm-up in his training regimen.
